_doc: Ship's officers (systems/shipOfficers.js). Four posts, each filled by promoting one of the ship's named hands (systems/deckLife.js roster). An officer has a skill (from the hand's aptitude for the post, growing with days at sea and fights won) and a loyalty (pay, arrears, rations, grog, floggings, victories and defeats, praise and reprimands, the crew's morale). Their bonuses (posts.<id>.bonuses: the most the post gives, at skill 100 and full heart) are read through ShipOfficers.bonus(ship, kind). minCrew: the crew the ship must need (crewRequired) to carry the post. Loyalty below sulkAt halves an officer's bonus; below desertAt in port, they may go ashore for good.

navigator.title: navigator
navigator.desc: Keeps the reckoning and the charts: a quicker passage, and a safer one through shoals and storms.

gunner.title: master gunner
gunner.desc: Lays the guns and drills their crews: truer broadsides.

bosun.title: bosun
bosun.desc: Drives the hands and keeps the rigging and hull in repair: steadier spirits, running repairs at sea.

surgeon.title: surgeon
surgeon.desc: Physics the sick and dresses the wounded: shorter outbreaks, more men saved after a fight.
